testsuite.name: com.crush.mobile.ui.screens.chat.ChatListContentTest

testcase.name: a live engine has no Start engine button
a stopped project engine offers a Start engine action
a loading project list says sessions
a stopped engine does not claim the list is empty
a project lists its own sessions with Review and New session
an unavailable list does not claim the chat pool is empty
Crush Chat lists legacy chats and starts with a New chat action
a recovered ambiguous run is visible as unresolved and detached
a loading chat list says chats
a refused start keeps the button and names the reason
